description: Tenant content plug-in contract. Catalog facts and assets are authored source data, not design tokens or generated UI copy.

policy.identity: Preserve canonical source keys; catalogId is separate display metadata. Never derive identity from translated labels or list positions.
policy.presentationBoundary: Components receive normalized records and callbacks. They do not scrape, fetch wiki facts, guess filenames, synthesize records, or interpret source modules.
policy.localization: UI messages and translated content are separate from canonical records. Join translations by stable record ID and locale; never overwrite source facts with generated text.

record.sourcePreservation: Keep raw gameplay fields and precision. Add presentation projections without rewriting descriptions, units, statistical formulas or source ordering.
record.artwork: Use declared asset mappings from the same revision. Explicit null is allowed only for sample artwork; a missing authoritative asset is an error.
record.filters: Options come from declared taxonomies or authored tenant definitions, not guessed labels. Unknown taxonomy values fail validation.

extensions.userBuilds: User-owned application persistence; never part of the authoritative game catalog.

joins: items key -> itemImages key -> public/items/<mapped filename>
constants DlcIconUrl -> imported local DLC artwork
ItemRarity / ItemRaritySortValue -> tenant rarity tokens / stable group ordering
Category -> public display categories; preserve internal category flags separately
ror2.revisionPolicy: Default builds use this exact revision. An explicitly supplied ref is resolved once to a commit and recorded in output. Change the pin deliberately after validating catalog and visual compatibility.

minecraft.revisionPolicy: Checked-in authored sample, never a gameplay authority or production fallback. Replace with a reviewed authoritative adapter before publishing a real Minecraft catalog.
